description: The 6 base precision tiers (v0.1.0). Each tier has a stable integer depth that the collapse operator uses for ordering. Tier depths are immutable across minor-version pack bumps; new tiers extend at the bottom of the scale or as named refinements.

unspecified.label: Unspecified
unspecified.description: LDU staging — the source asserted a value but the admission worker has not yet mapped it to a precision tier. Assertions at this tier are flowable but not authoritative; they cannot collapse or federate until promoted.
examples: raw LLM extraction before mapper runs
imported third-party data with no precision metadata
unspecified.promote_to: named | qualified | formal | spectral | enumerated (chosen by admission worker)

concept.label: Concept
concept.description: The property itself, with no value. Used as the root of the lattice for queries like 'does this entity have a color assertion at all?'

named.label: Named
named.description: A common-language token denoting the value. Cheapest assertion; what most natural-language extraction produces. No qualifier, no formal coding.

qualified.label: Qualified
qualified.description: A named value with a modifier or restriction. One step more specific than 'named' but still natural-language.

formal.label: Formal
formal.description: A value expressed in a standardized coding scheme — controlled vocabulary, model number, registry identifier, ISO code, etc. Machine-precise within the scheme's resolution.

spectral.label: Spectral / Measured
spectral.description: Direct physical measurement — wavelength, mass, length, instrument readout. Below this is the noise floor of the measurement itself; further refinement requires a new measurement.

enumerated.label: Enumerated (closed-list)
enumerated.description: A value from a fixed, closed enumeration where no further refinement is meaningful. Acts like depth=∞ for collapse purposes — alternative values at this tier are pure conflicts, not refinements of each other.
examples: language = 'en' (ISO 639-1 — there is no 'more specific' English at this tier)
mmsi = '366999712' (a vessel's MMSI is exact, not approximable)

collapse_ordering.rule: Within the same property and same lattice chain, an assertion at deeper depth SUBSUMES an assertion at shallower depth (deeper is preserved as canonical; shallower becomes a supporting attestation).
collapse_ordering.enumerated_special: enumerated values do not subsume named/qualified/formal of a different value — they're exact, so any disagreement at the enumerated tier is a real conflict.
collapse_ordering.unspecified_handling: unspecified-tier assertions are kept side-by-side but never collapse with each other or with tiered assertions; they must be promoted by the admission worker first.
